entries.reason: Authored: how far a bed's thickness departs from the period: beds alternate thicker and thinner, each by a drawn amount from a quarter of the spread to all of it, so no two in a row are equal. Below the period less 1 m, so a bed is at least 1 m; 0 is beds of one thickness.

entries.reason: Authored: the side of the square a volume's top land covers, centred on the volume's own origin, in whole 2 m so its corners lie on the land's 1 m lattice; from a 2 m crown to 128 m, the square round the top of an island about 58 m in radius. Measured: the land is realized whole at 1 m each time the volume's field is made (two to four times for a world on a landscape); a gently rolling land took 0.6 to 1.3 s for a 128 m square (16641 points) and 2.5 to 4.4 s for 256 m on one core of the development machine at load averages of 38 to 85 on 15 October 2026. A wider top is a later version, after timings on a quiet machine.
